subject: Priority remediation & premium path request from ClearWave — renewal implications
messages:
From: Mara Chen <mara@clearwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tomas Alvarez <tomas@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ongoing latency incidents — request for priority remediation + SLA path

Jordan —

Thanks for taking this. Over the last 3 weeks we've seen 4 distinct latency spikes that materially affected our checkout flow (avg 4s tail for short chat completions, and multiple 503s during peak). I've attached our internal incident log and a short usage snapshot.

We have a renewal conversation starting next month, and our leadership is asking for two things before we finalize: (1) a concrete remediation plan with timelines and (2) an option to move to a premium SLA and priority capacity pilot for Q4. At a minimum we need a documented path to 99.95% availability for our production model and a mechanism for operational credits if short-term targets aren't met.

Can you propose immediate mitigations and a path for an expedited premium pilot? Also flag any procurement steps you need from our side (SLA addendum, PO, etc.).

Attachments:
- incident_log_sep10.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
- clearwave_usage_snapshot_sep.csv (CSV, 28KB)

Thanks,
Mara
Mara Chen
Head of Product
ClearWave Inc.
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Mara Chen <mara@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency incidents — request for priority remediation + SLA path

Mara —

Really sorry to hear this — thank you for the detailed log. I'm looping in Rishi (our runtime ops lead) and Evelyn (CS) so we can triage and put a clear plan on the table. High level next steps from our side:

- Immediate triage: Rishi will review the incident traces and workload characteristics within 24 hours.
- Short-term mitigations: we can enable per-customer priority lanes and prefix caching to reduce tail latency during the pilot window.
- Premium pilot proposal: 6-week Priority Capacity pilot with a 99.95% target and a follow-on SLA addendum for renewal.
- Commercials: Evelyn will scope credit structure and a draft amendment to accelerate procurement.

I'll coordinate a short triage call today. What times work for you and Tomas?

— Jordan
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Mara Chen <mara@clearwave.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency incidents — request for priority remediation + SLA path

On Thu, Sep 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Mara —
> Really sorry to hear this — thank you for the detailed log. I'm looping in Rishi (our runtime ops lead) and Evelyn (CS) so we can triage and put a clear plan on the table.

Thanks Jordan. Mara / Tomas — quick technical summary and ask from our side:

- Initial read of your incident_log suggests tail latency correlates with sudden token-length spikes and concurrent burst traffic on a single model shard.
- We'll pull per-request traces (KV cache hit rates, batch sizes, sequence lengths) and check kernel selection decisions for the impacted windows. I can have preliminary findings within 18 hours.

Proposed short-term mitigations (configurable immediately):
- Enable priority lanes: reserve a small pool of prewarmed workers for ClearWave traffic, auto-escalate traffic when queueing exceeds threshold.
- Prefix-level KV caching for repeated prompt templates (should reduce token cost + tail).
- Temporary stricter rate limiting on background batch jobs if they collide with production spikes.

Commercial/terms note — from an ops perspective we can stand up a 6-week Priority Capacity pilot with a 99.95% availability goal. We typically couple pilots with a small monthly reserved capacity commitment to guarantee prewarmed resources. I'll propose exact numbers after review.

I will upload the traces and a short analysis to the shared drive link (below) once ready.

— Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Mara Chen <mara@clearwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tomas Alvarez <tomas@clearwave.com>, procurement@clearwave.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency incidents — request for priority remediation + SLA path

Jordan / Rishi —

Appreciate the quick responses. A 6-week pilot sounds reasonable; we need two clarifications before we commit: (1) written remediation milestones (what you will do week-by-week) and (2) defined credit mechanics if the 99.95% target is missed.

On procurement — our legal team will need to see a redline to the current MSA that outlines pilot terms, credit formulas, and a one-click path to upgrade to the premium SLA for renewal. Please send us the draft SLA addendum and any PO/contract language we should prepare.

We can do a kickoff call Monday 14th at 10am PT.

— Mara
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@clearwave.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mara Chen <mara@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency incidents — request for priority remediation + SLA path

Mara / ClearWave procurement —

I've attached a proposed SLA addendum with redlines focused on: pilot duration, metrics & measurement windows, credit formula (pro rata monthly credits tied to missed availability), and a defined upgrade mechanism into a 12-month Premium Tier. For speed, we've put the DocuSign powerform link below; if you prefer direct redlines, please let me know and I'll send a tracked copy.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Mara Chen <mara@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency incidents — request for priority remediation + SLA path

Mara —

Great kickoff this morning. Quick recap / agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Pilot & timeline: 6-week Priority Capacity pilot starting Sep 20 — Oct 31. Redwood will allocate a reserved prewarmed pool sized for your 99th percentile peak; Rishi to share exact capacity numbers by EOD 9/16.
2) Remediation milestones: Week 0 (triage + config changes); Week 1 (enable priority lanes + KV prefix caching); Weeks 2–3 (kernel selection tuning & telemetry instrumentation); Weeks 4–6 (stability validation and handover).
3) Metrics & credits: target availability 99.95% measured on a rolling 30-day window. If missed, credit = (shortfall % * monthly reserved fee). Laura's addendum has the draft formula.
4) Procurement: ClearWave to sign SLA addendum via DocuSign and issue a PO for the reserved capacity commit. Laura to accept direct redlines if needed.
5) Checkpoints: Weekly ops call, biweekly executive check-in if issues persist.

I'll follow up with the capacity sizing numbers and the drive link to our trace analysis. Thanks to Tomas for the diagnostic help during the call. Looking forward to stabilizing things quickly.

— Jordan
